title: Earth Day world
slide_intent: Give a themed collection its own image language so viewers can understand the topic before reading supporting copy.
strategic_value: The illustrated environment can make Channel 4’s Earth Day collection distinct within the shared world concept.
demonstration: Bold white EARTH DAY lettering crosses a colorful illustrated landscape of plants, trees and abstract natural forms.
practical_value: Compare how the subject’s visual vocabulary can fill a branded content world.
